chunks.title_path: Assistant guide / What can you do
chunks.text: What can you do: the knowledge assistant supports product and operations FAQ, trade-rule explanations, and explanations of selected document text. Answers include claim-level citations, support_level and limitations; when evidence is insufficient it says so, and when a request is out of scope it suggests a handoff. This is a synthetic demo guide, not official product documentation.

chunks.section: What can this assistant not do
chunks.title_path: Assistant guide / What can this assistant not do
chunks.text: What can this assistant not do: it does not edit the document, approve, submit, browse the web, provide legal conclusions or replace sanctions screening. Edit, approval or full compliance-review requests are handed off; it produces no document or business side effects.

locator.section: What can this assistant not do

chunks.title_path: Assistant guide / How should I ask
chunks.text: How should I ask: include the rule name, version, jurisdiction or applicable date; select a passage before asking about the document; ask one question at a time. Example: What does URDG 758 article 20 require for claims? or What does this passage mean?

chunks.title_path: Assistant guide / How to read an answer
chunks.text: How to read an answer: answers include outcome, support_level, claims, citations and limitations. strong or qualified indicates support; insufficient_evidence means evidence is missing; needs_handoff means the request must be handed off. Citation cards show only the approved excerpt and locator.
